title: Wild Mushroom Tacos
description: A flavorful and vibrant Mexican dish featuring wild mushrooms, perfect for a dinner option.
instructions: Sauté the wild mushrooms in a pan until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Warm the com tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the wild mushrooms onto a tortilla, followed by a spoonful of tam chay.
Sprinkle chopped cilantro and a pinch of salt over the top of each taco.
Drizzle a squeeze of lime juice over the tacos and serve immediately.
Optional: add chopped habanero peppers to the tacos for an extra spicy kick.
